name: MarkdownLiveEditor
description: A real-time Markdown editor with live preview support, featuring automatic scrolling synchronization and full support for right-to-left (RTL) languages. Built using CodeMirror and Marked.js, this editor is perfect for creating and rendering Markdown with a smooth, intuitive interface.
